Q1a.en: The function \(f(x) = 3x\) is one-one, because \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\) gives \(3x_1 = 3x_2\), so \(x_1 = x_2\). It is onto, because every real number \(y\) is the image of the real number \(x = \frac{y}{3}\): \(f\left(\frac{y}{3}\right) = y\). So \(f\) is one-one and onto, which is the choice "one-one and onto".
Q1a.hi: फलन \(f(x) = 3x\) एकैकी है, क्योंकि \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\) से \(3x_1 = 3x_2\) अर्थात् \(x_1 = x_2\) प्राप्त होता है। यह आच्छादक भी है, क्योंकि प्रत्येक वास्तविक संख्या \(y\) वास्तविक संख्या \(x = \frac{y}{3}\) का प्रतिबिम्ब है: \(f\left(\frac{y}{3}\right) = y\)। अतः \(f\) एकैकी व आच्छादक है, जो विकल्प "एकैकी व आच्छादक" है।

Q1b.en: The image of \(X\) is \(f(X) = \{f(a), f(b), f(c)\} = \{2, 3, 1\} = Y\). As in NCERT, the sign \(\subset\) means "is a subset of" and allows equality, since every set is a subset of itself. As \(f(X) = Y\), we have \(f(X) \subset Y\), \(f(X) = Y\), and also \(Y \subset f(X)\), that is \(f(X) \supset Y\). All three statements are true, which is the choice "All of these".
Q1b.hi: \(X\) का प्रतिबिम्ब \(f(X) = \{f(a), f(b), f(c)\} = \{2, 3, 1\} = Y\) है। NCERT के अनुसार चिह्न \(\subset\) का अर्थ "उपसमुच्चय है" है, जिसमें समानता भी सम्मिलित है, क्योंकि प्रत्येक समुच्चय स्वयं का उपसमुच्चय होता है। चूँकि \(f(X) = Y\), अतः \(f(X) \subset Y\), \(f(X) = Y\) तथा \(Y \subset f(X)\) अर्थात् \(f(X) \supset Y\), तीनों कथन सत्य हैं। अतः सही विकल्प "इनमें से सभी" है।

Q1c.en: Integrate by parts, taking \(\log x\) as the first function and \(1\) as the second: \(\int \log x \, dx = \log x \cdot x - \int \frac{1}{x} \cdot x \, dx = x \log x - x + c\). Comparing with \(x \log x + k(x) + c\) gives \(k(x) = -x\), which is the choice \(k(x) = -x\).
Q1c.hi: खंडशः समाकलन से, \(\log x\) को प्रथम फलन तथा \(1\) को द्वितीय फलन लेकर: \(\int \log x \, dx = \log x \cdot x - \int \frac{1}{x} \cdot x \, dx = x \log x - x + c\)। इसकी तुलना \(x \log x + k(x) + c\) से करने पर \(k(x) = -x\) प्राप्त होता है, जो विकल्प \(k(x) = -x\) है।

Q1d.en: The number of arbitrary constants in the general solution of a differential equation is equal to its order. A differential equation of order five therefore has 5 arbitrary constants in its general solution, which is the choice 5.
Q1d.hi: किसी अवकल समीकरण के व्यापक हल में स्वेच्छ अचरों की संख्या उसकी कोटि के बराबर होती है। अतः पाँच कोटि वाले अवकल समीकरण के व्यापक हल में 5 स्वेच्छ अचर होते हैं, जो विकल्प 5 है।

Q1e.en: The slope (derivative) of a vector function is found by differentiating each component with respect to \(t\): \(\frac{d\vec{f}}{dt} = 0\hat{i} + 0\hat{j} + 10t\hat{k} = 10t\hat{k}\). At \(t = 2\) this is \(20\hat{k}\), which is the choice \(20\hat{k}\).
Q1e.hi: सदिश फलन की प्रवणता (अवकलज) प्रत्येक घटक का \(t\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करके प्राप्त होती है: \(\frac{d\vec{f}}{dt} = 0\hat{i} + 0\hat{j} + 10t\hat{k} = 10t\hat{k}\)। \(t = 2\) पर यह \(20\hat{k}\) है, जो विकल्प \(20\hat{k}\) है।

Q2a.en:
Let \(\sin^{-1} x = \theta\), where \(-1 < x < 1\), so that \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\) and \(x = \sin\theta\). In this interval \(\cos\theta > 0\), so \(\cos\theta = \sqrt{1 - \sin^2\theta} = \sqrt{1 - x^2}\).
Then \(\tan\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\), and since \(\theta\) lies in \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), \(\theta = \tan^{-1}\frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\).
Hence \(\sin^{-1} x = \tan^{-1}\left[\frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\right]\).
Q2a.hi:
माना \(\sin^{-1} x = \theta\), जहाँ \(-1 < x < 1\), तब \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\) तथा \(x = \sin\theta\)। इस अन्तराल में \(\cos\theta > 0\), अतः \(\cos\theta = \sqrt{1 - \sin^2\theta} = \sqrt{1 - x^2}\)।
तब \(\tan\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\), और चूँकि \(\theta\) अन्तराल \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) में है, \(\theta = \tan^{-1}\frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\)।
अतः \(\sin^{-1} x = \tan^{-1}\left[\frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\right]\)।

Q2b.en:
The magnitude of the vector is \(|\vec{a}| = \sqrt{2^2 + 3^2 + 1^2} = \sqrt{14}\). So the unit vector along \(\vec{a}\) is
\(\hat{a} = \frac{\vec{a}}{|\vec{a}|} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}(2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + \hat{k}) = \frac{2}{\sqrt{14}}\hat{i} + \frac{3}{\sqrt{14}}\hat{j} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}\hat{k}\).
Q2b.hi:
सदिश का परिमाण \(|\vec{a}| = \sqrt{2^2 + 3^2 + 1^2} = \sqrt{14}\) है। अतः \(\vec{a}\) के अनुदिश मात्रक सदिश
\(\hat{a} = \frac{\vec{a}}{|\vec{a}|} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}(2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + \hat{k}) = \frac{2}{\sqrt{14}}\hat{i} + \frac{3}{\sqrt{14}}\hat{j} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}\hat{k}\) है।

Q2c.en: The sum of the vectors is \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} = (3 - 2)\hat{i} + (4 - 3)\hat{j} + (-3 + 1)\hat{k} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\), and its magnitude is \(\sqrt{1^2 + 1^2 + (-2)^2} = \sqrt{6}\). So the direction cosines of the sum are \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}, \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}, -\frac{2}{\sqrt{6}}\).
Q2c.hi: सदिशों का योगफल \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} = (3 - 2)\hat{i} + (4 - 3)\hat{j} + (-3 + 1)\hat{k} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\) है, जिसका परिमाण \(\sqrt{1^2 + 1^2 + (-2)^2} = \sqrt{6}\) है। अतः योगफल की दिक्-कोज्याएँ \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}, \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}, -\frac{2}{\sqrt{6}}\) हैं।

Q2d.en: For every real \(x\), \((gof)(x) = g(f(x)) = g(\cos x) = 3(\cos x)^2 = 3\cos^2 x\). So \(gof : R \rightarrow R\) is given by \((gof)(x) = 3\cos^2 x\).
Q2d.hi: प्रत्येक वास्तविक \(x\) के लिए \((gof)(x) = g(f(x)) = g(\cos x) = 3(\cos x)^2 = 3\cos^2 x\)। अतः \(gof : R \rightarrow R\), \((gof)(x) = 3\cos^2 x\) द्वारा परिभाषित है।

Q2e.en: When two dice are thrown, there are \(6 \times 6 = 36\) equally likely outcomes. The outcomes with sum eight are \((2, 6), (3, 5), (4, 4), (5, 3), (6, 2)\), that is 5 outcomes. So the required probability is \(\frac{5}{36}\).
Q2e.hi: दो पासे फेंकने पर कुल \(6 \times 6 = 36\) समसम्भाव्य परिणाम होते हैं। योगफल आठ वाले परिणाम \((2, 6), (3, 5), (4, 4), (5, 3), (6, 2)\) हैं, अर्थात् 5 परिणाम। अतः अभीष्ट प्रायिकता \(\frac{5}{36}\) है।

Q3a.en:
The vector \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) is the position vector of the point \(B\) minus the position vector of the point \(A\):
\(\overrightarrow{AB} = (2\hat{i} + 5\hat{j}) - (\hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}) = \hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - \hat{k}\).
\(|\overrightarrow{AB}| = \sqrt{1^2 + 4^2 + (-1)^2} = \sqrt{18} = 3\sqrt{2}\).
So the unit vector along the line \(AB\) is
\(\frac{\overrightarrow{AB}}{|\overrightarrow{AB}|} = \frac{1}{3\sqrt{2}}(\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - \hat{k}) = \frac{1}{3\sqrt{2}}\hat{i} + \frac{4}{3\sqrt{2}}\hat{j} - \frac{1}{3\sqrt{2}}\hat{k}\).
Q3a.hi:
सदिश \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) = बिन्दु \(B\) का स्थिति सदिश \(-\) बिन्दु \(A\) का स्थिति सदिश:
\(\overrightarrow{AB} = (2\hat{i} + 5\hat{j}) - (\hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}) = \hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - \hat{k}\)।
\(|\overrightarrow{AB}| = \sqrt{1^2 + 4^2 + (-1)^2} = \sqrt{18} = 3\sqrt{2}\)।
अतः सरल रेखा \(AB\) की दिशा में मात्रक सदिश
\(\frac{\overrightarrow{AB}}{|\overrightarrow{AB}|} = \frac{1}{3\sqrt{2}}(\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - \hat{k}) = \frac{1}{3\sqrt{2}}\hat{i} + \frac{4}{3\sqrt{2}}\hat{j} - \frac{1}{3\sqrt{2}}\hat{k}\) है।

Q3c.en:
The equation \(y = 2mx\) has one arbitrary constant \(m\), so differentiate once with respect to \(x\): \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 2m\).
Putting \(2m = \frac{dy}{dx}\) in \(y = 2mx\) gives \(y = x\frac{dy}{dx}\).
So the required differential equation is \(x\frac{dy}{dx} - y = 0\).
Q3c.hi:
समीकरण \(y = 2mx\) में एक स्वेच्छ अचर \(m\) है, अतः \(x\) के सापेक्ष एक बार अवकलन करने पर \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 2m\)।
\(2m = \frac{dy}{dx}\) को \(y = 2mx\) में रखने पर \(y = x\frac{dy}{dx}\)।
अतः अभीष्ट अवकल समीकरण \(x\frac{dy}{dx} - y = 0\) है।

Q3d.en:
Since \((A')' = A\), we have \(C = AB\). The matrix \(A\) is of order \(2 \times 3\) and the matrix \(B\) is of order \(3 \times 2\), so \(C\) is of order \(2 \times 2\):
\(C = \begin{bmatrix} 3 \cdot 0 + \sqrt{3} \cdot 0 + 2 \cdot \frac{1}{2} & 3 \cdot \frac{1}{4} + \sqrt{3} \cdot 0 + 2 \cdot \frac{1}{8} \\ 4 \cdot 0 + 2 \cdot 0 + 0 \cdot \frac{1}{2} & 4 \cdot \frac{1}{4} + 2 \cdot 0 + 0 \cdot \frac{1}{8} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\).
So \(|C| = 1 \cdot 1 - 1 \cdot 0 = 1\). Hence proved.
Q3d.hi:
चूँकि \((A')' = A\), अतः \(C = AB\)। आव्यूह \(A\) की कोटि \(2 \times 3\) तथा आव्यूह \(B\) की कोटि \(3 \times 2\) है, अतः \(C\) की कोटि \(2 \times 2\) होगी:
\(C = \begin{bmatrix} 3 \cdot 0 + \sqrt{3} \cdot 0 + 2 \cdot \frac{1}{2} & 3 \cdot \frac{1}{4} + \sqrt{3} \cdot 0 + 2 \cdot \frac{1}{8} \\ 4 \cdot 0 + 2 \cdot 0 + 0 \cdot \frac{1}{2} & 4 \cdot \frac{1}{4} + 2 \cdot 0 + 0 \cdot \frac{1}{8} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\)।
अतः \(|C| = 1 \cdot 1 - 1 \cdot 0 = 1\)। यही सिद्ध करना था।

Q4a.en:
The vector equation of the line through the point with position vector \(\vec{a}\) and parallel to the vector \(\vec{b}\) is \(\vec{r} = \vec{a} + \lambda\vec{b}\).
Here \(\vec{a} = 5\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b} = 3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 8\hat{k}\). So the required equation is
\(\vec{r} = 5\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 4\hat{k} + \lambda(3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 8\hat{k})\), where \(\lambda\) is a real number.
Q4a.hi:
स्थिति सदिश \(\vec{a}\) वाले बिन्दु से जाने वाली तथा सदिश \(\vec{b}\) के समान्तर रेखा का सदिश समीकरण \(\vec{r} = \vec{a} + \lambda\vec{b}\) होता है।
यहाँ \(\vec{a} = 5\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\) तथा \(\vec{b} = 3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 8\hat{k}\)। अतः अभीष्ट समीकरण
\(\vec{r} = 5\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 4\hat{k} + \lambda(3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 8\hat{k})\) है, जहाँ \(\lambda\) एक वास्तविक संख्या है।

Q4b.en:
After cutting a square of side \(2x\) m from each corner and folding up the flaps, the box has length \((16 - 4x)\) m, breadth \((6 - 4x)\) m and height \(2x\) m, where \(0 < x < \frac{3}{2}\).
Volume \(V = 2x(16 - 4x)(6 - 4x) = 16(2x^3 - 11x^2 + 12x)\).
\(\frac{dV}{dx} = 16(6x^2 - 22x + 12) = 32(3x - 2)(x - 3)\). Putting \(\frac{dV}{dx} = 0\) gives \(x = \frac{2}{3}\) or \(x = 3\); only \(x = \frac{2}{3}\) is possible, since \(x < \frac{3}{2}\).
\(\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = 16(12x - 22)\), which at \(x = \frac{2}{3}\) equals \(16(8 - 22) = -224 < 0\), so the volume is maximum at \(x = \frac{2}{3}\).
Maximum volume \(= \frac{4}{3} \times \frac{40}{3} \times \frac{10}{3} = \frac{1600}{27} \text{ m}^3 \approx 59.26 \text{ m}^3\).

Q4c.en:
For independent events \(A\) and \(B\), \(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B)\). So
\(P(B/A) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(A)} = \frac{P(A) \cdot P(B)}{P(A)} = P(B) = 0.4\).
Q4c.hi:
स्वतन्त्र घटनाओं \(A\) और \(B\) के लिए \(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B)\)। अतः
\(P(B/A) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(A)} = \frac{P(A) \cdot P(B)}{P(A)} = P(B) = 0.4\)।

Q4d.en:
Take the sides from the vertex \(A(2, 2, 2)\):
\(\overrightarrow{AB} = (2 - 2)\hat{i} + (1 - 2)\hat{j} + (3 - 2)\hat{k} = -\hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\overrightarrow{AC} = (3 - 2)\hat{i} + (2 - 2)\hat{j} + (1 - 2)\hat{k} = \hat{i} - \hat{k}\).
\(\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 0 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & -1 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(1 - 0) - \hat{j}(0 - 1) + \hat{k}(0 + 1) = \hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}\).
Area of the triangle \(= \frac{1}{2}|\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC}| = \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{1^2 + 1^2 + 1^2} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) square units.
Q4d.hi:
शीर्ष \(A(2, 2, 2)\) से भुजाएँ लेने पर:
\(\overrightarrow{AB} = (2 - 2)\hat{i} + (1 - 2)\hat{j} + (3 - 2)\hat{k} = -\hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\overrightarrow{AC} = (3 - 2)\hat{i} + (2 - 2)\hat{j} + (1 - 2)\hat{k} = \hat{i} - \hat{k}\)।
\(\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 0 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & -1 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(1 - 0) - \hat{j}(0 - 1) + \hat{k}(0 + 1) = \hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}\)।
त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{1}{2}|\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC}| = \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{1^2 + 1^2 + 1^2} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) वर्ग इकाई।

Q5a.en:
Here \(Y = \{y \in N : y = 4x + 3 \text{ for some } x \in N\}\) is exactly the range of \(f\). A function is invertible if and only if it is one-one and onto.
**One-one:** let \(x_1, x_2 \in N\) with \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\). Then \(4x_1 + 3 = 4x_2 + 3\), so \(4x_1 = 4x_2\) and \(x_1 = x_2\). Hence \(f\) is one-one.
**Onto:** let \(y \in Y\). By the definition of \(Y\), \(y = 4x + 3\) for some \(x \in N\), so \(x = \frac{y - 3}{4} \in N\) and \(f\left(\frac{y - 3}{4}\right) = 4 \cdot \frac{y - 3}{4} + 3 = y\). So every element of \(Y\) has a pre-image in \(N\), and \(f\) is onto.
Therefore \(f\) is one-one and onto, hence invertible.
**Inverse:** define \(g : Y \rightarrow N\) by \(g(y) = \frac{y - 3}{4}\). Then
\((gof)(x) = g(4x + 3) = \frac{(4x + 3) - 3}{4} = x\) for all \(x \in N\), so \(gof = I_N\);
\((fog)(y) = f\left(\frac{y - 3}{4}\right) = 4 \cdot \frac{y - 3}{4} + 3 = y\) for all \(y \in Y\), so \(fog = I_Y\).
Hence \(f^{-1} : Y \rightarrow N\) is given by \(f^{-1}(y) = \frac{y - 3}{4}\).
Q5a.hi:
यहाँ \(Y = \{y \in N : \text{किसी } x \in N \text{ के लिए } y = 4x + 3\}\) ठीक \(f\) का परिसर है। कोई फलन व्युत्क्रमणीय तभी होता है जब वह एकैकी तथा आच्छादक हो।
**एकैकी:** माना \(x_1, x_2 \in N\) के लिए \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\)। तब \(4x_1 + 3 = 4x_2 + 3\), अतः \(4x_1 = 4x_2\) तथा \(x_1 = x_2\)। अतः \(f\) एकैकी है।
**आच्छादक:** माना \(y \in Y\)। \(Y\) की परिभाषा से किसी \(x \in N\) के लिए \(y = 4x + 3\), अतः \(x = \frac{y - 3}{4} \in N\) तथा \(f\left(\frac{y - 3}{4}\right) = 4 \cdot \frac{y - 3}{4} + 3 = y\)। इस प्रकार \(Y\) के प्रत्येक अवयव का \(N\) में पूर्व-प्रतिबिम्ब है, अतः \(f\) आच्छादक है।
अतः \(f\) एकैकी तथा आच्छादक है, इसलिए व्युत्क्रमणीय है।
**प्रतिलोम फलन:** \(g : Y \rightarrow N\), \(g(y) = \frac{y - 3}{4}\) द्वारा परिभाषित कीजिए। तब
सभी \(x \in N\) के लिए \((gof)(x) = g(4x + 3) = \frac{(4x + 3) - 3}{4} = x\), अतः \(gof = I_N\);
सभी \(y \in Y\) के लिए \((fog)(y) = f\left(\frac{y - 3}{4}\right) = 4 \cdot \frac{y - 3}{4} + 3 = y\), अतः \(fog = I_Y\)।
अतः \(f^{-1} : Y \rightarrow N\), \(f^{-1}(y) = \frac{y - 3}{4}\) द्वारा प्रदत्त है।

Q5b.en:
Draw the lines \(2x - y = -5\) (through \((0, 5)\) and \(\left(-\frac{5}{2}, 0\right)\)), \(3x + y = 3\) (through \((0, 3)\) and \((1, 0)\)) and \(2x - 3y = 12\) (through \((6, 0)\) and \((0, -4)\)).
- \(2x - y \geq -5\): the origin satisfies it (\(0 \geq -5\)), so the region is on the origin side of \(2x - y = -5\).
- \(3x + y \geq 3\): the origin does not satisfy it, so the region is away from the origin.
- \(2x - 3y \leq 12\): the origin satisfies it, so the region is on the origin side of \(2x - 3y = 12\).
- \(x \geq 0, y \geq 0\): the first quadrant.
The feasible region is unbounded (it extends without limit between the lines \(2x - y = -5\) and \(2x - 3y = 12\), which do not meet in the first quadrant). Its corner points are \((0, 5)\), \((0, 3)\), \((1, 0)\) and \((6, 0)\).

| Corner point | \(Z = -50x + 20y\) |
|---|---|
| \((0, 5)\) | \(100\) |
| \((0, 3)\) | \(60\) |
| \((1, 0)\) | \(-50\) |
| \((6, 0)\) | \(-300\) (smallest) |

The smallest value at a corner is \(-300\) at \((6, 0)\). Since the region is unbounded, draw the open half-plane \(-50x + 20y < -300\), that is \(5x - 2y > 30\). Q5c.en:
Since the matrices \(A\) and \(B\) of order \(n\) are invertible, \(|A| \neq 0\) and \(|B| \neq 0\). Then \(|AB| = |A||B| \neq 0\), so \(AB\) is also invertible.
Now, using the associative law of matrix multiplication,
\((AB)(B^{-1}A^{-1}) = A(BB^{-1})A^{-1} = AIA^{-1} = AA^{-1} = I\),
\((B^{-1}A^{-1})(AB) = B^{-1}(A^{-1}A)B = B^{-1}IB = B^{-1}B = I\).
Thus \((AB)(B^{-1}A^{-1}) = (B^{-1}A^{-1})(AB) = I\), so by the definition of the inverse of a matrix, \(B^{-1}A^{-1}\) is the inverse of \(AB\). Since the inverse of a matrix is unique,
\((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\). Hence proved.

Q5d.en:
Let \(\theta\) be the angle between \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\). By the definition of the scalar product, \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = |\vec{a}||\vec{b}|\cos\theta \leq |\vec{a}||\vec{b}|\), because \(\cos\theta \leq 1\).
Now
\(|\vec{a} + \vec{b}|^2 = (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = \vec{a} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{b}\)
\(= |\vec{a}|^2 + 2\,\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + |\vec{b}|^2\) (since \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a}\))
\(\leq |\vec{a}|^2 + 2|\vec{a}||\vec{b}| + |\vec{b}|^2 = (|\vec{a}| + |\vec{b}|)^2\).
Both \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b}|\) and \(|\vec{a}| + |\vec{b}|\) are non-negative, so taking square roots,
\(|\vec{a} + \vec{b}| \leq |\vec{a}| + |\vec{b}|\). Hence proved.
Equality holds only when \(\cos\theta = 1\), that is when \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\) have the same direction. Geometrically: if \(\overrightarrow{PQ} = \vec{a}\) and \(\overrightarrow{QR} = \vec{b}\) in a triangle \(PQR\), then \(\overrightarrow{PR} = \vec{a} + \vec{b}\), and the inequality says that a side of a triangle is less than the sum of the other two sides (triangle inequality).
Q5d.hi:
माना \(\vec{a}\) तथा \(\vec{b}\) के बीच का कोण \(\theta\) है। अदिश गुणनफल की परिभाषा से \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = |\vec{a}||\vec{b}|\cos\theta \leq |\vec{a}||\vec{b}|\), क्योंकि \(\cos\theta \leq 1\)।
अब
\(|\vec{a} + \vec{b}|^2 = (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = \vec{a} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{b}\)
\(= |\vec{a}|^2 + 2\,\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + |\vec{b}|^2\) (क्योंकि \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a}\))
\(\leq |\vec{a}|^2 + 2|\vec{a}||\vec{b}| + |\vec{b}|^2 = (|\vec{a}| + |\vec{b}|)^2\)।
\(|\vec{a} + \vec{b}|\) तथा \(|\vec{a}| + |\vec{b}|\) दोनों ऋणेतर हैं, अतः वर्गमूल लेने पर
\(|\vec{a} + \vec{b}| \leq |\vec{a}| + |\vec{b}|\)। यही सिद्ध करना था।
समता केवल तब होती है जब \(\cos\theta = 1\), अर्थात् जब \(\vec{a}\) तथा \(\vec{b}\) की दिशा एक ही हो। ज्यामितीय रूप से: यदि त्रिभुज \(PQR\) में \(\overrightarrow{PQ} = \vec{a}\) तथा \(\overrightarrow{QR} = \vec{b}\), तो \(\overrightarrow{PR} = \vec{a} + \vec{b}\), और यह असमिका बताती है कि त्रिभुज की कोई भुजा शेष दो भुजाओं के योग से छोटी होती है (त्रिभुज असमिका)।

Q5e.en:
Writing \(\sqrt{\tan x} = \frac{\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\cos x}}\),
\(I = \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} \frac{\sqrt{\cos x}}{\sqrt{\cos x} + \sqrt{\sin x}}\, dx\) ...(1)
Use the property \(\int_a^b f(x)\, dx = \int_a^b f(a + b - x)\, dx\). Here \(a + b = \frac{\pi}{6} + \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{\pi}{2}\), and \(\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right) = \sin x\), \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right) = \cos x\). So
\(I = \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} \frac{\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\sin x} + \sqrt{\cos x}}\, dx\) ...(2)
Adding (1) and (2):
\(2I = \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} \frac{\sqrt{\cos x} + \sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\cos x} + \sqrt{\sin x}}\, dx = \int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} 1\, dx = \left[x\right]_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3} = \frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\pi}{6}\).
Hence \(I = \frac{\pi}{12}\). Hence proved.

Q6a.en:
We show that \(f\) is continuous at every real number \(c\).
**Case 1: \(c \neq 0\).** Near \(c\), \(f(x) = x^2 \sin\frac{1}{x}\). Here \(x^2\) is a polynomial, hence continuous, and \(\sin\frac{1}{x}\) is the composite of the functions \(\frac{1}{x}\) (continuous for \(x \neq 0\)) and \(\sin x\) (continuous everywhere), hence continuous. Their product is continuous, so
\(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = c^2 \sin\frac{1}{c} = f(c)\).
**Case 2: \(c = 0\).** For \(x \neq 0\), \(-1 \leq \sin\frac{1}{x} \leq 1\), and multiplying by \(x^2 \geq 0\),
\(-x^2 \leq x^2 \sin\frac{1}{x} \leq x^2\).
Since \(\lim_{x \to 0} (-x^2) = 0\) and \(\lim_{x \to 0} x^2 = 0\), by the sandwich theorem \(\lim_{x \to 0} x^2 \sin\frac{1}{x} = 0\). So the left hand limit and the right hand limit at \(0\) are both \(0\), and \(f(0) = 0\). Thus \(\lim_{x \to 0} f(x) = f(0)\) and \(f\) is continuous at \(x = 0\).
Hence \(f\) is continuous at every point of its domain, that is, \(f\) is a continuous function.
Q6a.hi:
हम दर्शाएँगे कि \(f\) प्रत्येक वास्तविक संख्या \(c\) पर संतत है।
**स्थिति 1: \(c \neq 0\)।** \(c\) के निकट \(f(x) = x^2 \sin\frac{1}{x}\)। यहाँ \(x^2\) एक बहुपद है, अतः संतत है, तथा \(\sin\frac{1}{x}\) फलनों \(\frac{1}{x}\) (\(x \neq 0\) के लिए संतत) तथा \(\sin x\) (सर्वत्र संतत) का संयुक्त फलन है, अतः संतत है। दो संतत फलनों का गुणनफल संतत होता है, अतः
\(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = c^2 \sin\frac{1}{c} = f(c)\)।
**स्थिति 2: \(c = 0\)।** \(x \neq 0\) के लिए \(-1 \leq \sin\frac{1}{x} \leq 1\), तथा \(x^2 \geq 0\) से गुणा करने पर
\(-x^2 \leq x^2 \sin\frac{1}{x} \leq x^2\)।
चूँकि \(\lim_{x \to 0} (-x^2) = 0\) तथा \(\lim_{x \to 0} x^2 = 0\), अतः सैंडविच प्रमेय से \(\lim_{x \to 0} x^2 \sin\frac{1}{x} = 0\)। इस प्रकार \(0\) पर बायाँ पक्ष सीमा तथा दायाँ पक्ष सीमा दोनों \(0\) हैं, तथा \(f(0) = 0\)। अतः \(\lim_{x \to 0} f(x) = f(0)\) और \(f\), \(x = 0\) पर संतत है।
अतः \(f\) अपने प्रान्त के प्रत्येक बिन्दु पर संतत है, अर्थात् \(f\) एक संतत फलन है।

Q6b.en:
The distance covered is \(x = t^2\left(3 - \frac{t}{2}\right) = 3t^2 - \frac{t^3}{2}\).
Velocity \(v = \frac{dx}{dt} = 6t - \frac{3t^2}{2} = \frac{3t}{2}(4 - t)\).
The car stops at the point \(Q\), so its velocity there is zero: \(\frac{3t}{2}(4 - t) = 0\), giving \(t = 0\) or \(t = 4\).
At \(t = 0\) the car is starting from \(P\), so it reaches \(Q\) at \(t = 4\). (For \(0 < t < 4\), \(v > 0\), so the car keeps moving forward until it stops at \(Q\).)
Distance covered in 4 seconds: \(x = 4^2\left(3 - \frac{4}{2}\right) = 16 \times 1 = 16\) m, and at \(t = 0\), \(x = 0\).
Hence the car takes 4 seconds to reach \(Q\), and the distance between \(P\) and \(Q\) is 16 metres.
Q6b.hi:
तय की गई दूरी \(x = t^2\left(3 - \frac{t}{2}\right) = 3t^2 - \frac{t^3}{2}\) है।
वेग \(v = \frac{dx}{dt} = 6t - \frac{3t^2}{2} = \frac{3t}{2}(4 - t)\)।
कार बिन्दु \(Q\) पर रुक जाती है, अतः वहाँ उसका वेग शून्य है: \(\frac{3t}{2}(4 - t) = 0\), जिससे \(t = 0\) या \(t = 4\)।
\(t = 0\) पर कार \(P\) से चलना प्रारम्भ करती है, अतः वह \(t = 4\) पर \(Q\) पहुँचती है। (\(0 < t < 4\) के लिए \(v > 0\), अतः कार \(Q\) पर रुकने तक आगे ही बढ़ती है।)
4 सेकण्ड में तय दूरी: \(x = 4^2\left(3 - \frac{4}{2}\right) = 16 \times 1 = 16\) मीटर, तथा \(t = 0\) पर \(x = 0\)।
अतः कार को \(Q\) तक पहुँचने में 4 सेकण्ड लगते हैं, तथा \(P\) और \(Q\) के बीच की दूरी 16 मीटर है।

Q6c.en:
Compare each line with \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda\vec{b}_1\) and \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu\vec{b}_2\):
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\), \(\vec{b}_1 = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_2 = 3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\).
The shortest distance is \(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)}{|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2|}\right|\).
\(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 0\hat{j} - \hat{k}\).
\(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2 = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 3 & -5 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-2 + 5) - \hat{j}(4 - 3) + \hat{k}(-10 + 3) = 3\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 7\hat{k}\).
\(|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{9 + 1 + 49} = \sqrt{59}\).
\((\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = 3(1) + (-1)(0) + (-7)(-1) = 10\).
Hence the shortest distance \(d = \frac{10}{\sqrt{59}}\) units.

Q6d.en:
Given \(y = \cos^{-1} x\), where \(-1 < x < 1\). Differentiating with respect to \(x\):
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\), that is \(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{dy}{dx} = -1\).
Differentiating again with respect to \(x\) (product rule):
\(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + \frac{dy}{dx} \cdot \frac{-2x}{2\sqrt{1 - x^2}} = 0\), that is \(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\,\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\).
Multiplying by \(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\):
\((1 - x^2)\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - x\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\). Hence shown.
Q6d.hi:
दिया है \(y = \cos^{-1} x\), जहाँ \(-1 < x < 1\)। \(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\), अर्थात् \(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{dy}{dx} = -1\)।
पुनः \(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर (गुणनफल नियम से):
\(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + \frac{dy}{dx} \cdot \frac{-2x}{2\sqrt{1 - x^2}} = 0\), अर्थात् \(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\,\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\)।
\(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\) से गुणा करने पर:
\((1 - x^2)\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - x\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\)। यही दर्शाना था।

Q6e.en:
Let \(X\), \(Y\), \(Z\) be the three events (named \(x, y, z\) in the print), with \(P(X) > 0\) and \(P(X \cap Y) > 0\).
By the definition of conditional probability,
\(P\left(\frac{Y}{X}\right) = \frac{P(X \cap Y)}{P(X)}\), so \(P(X \cap Y) = P(X) \cdot P\left(\frac{Y}{X}\right)\) ...(1)
Treating \(X \cap Y\) as one event,
\(P\left(\frac{Z}{X \cap Y}\right) = \frac{P((X \cap Y) \cap Z)}{P(X \cap Y)}\), so \(P(X \cap Y \cap Z) = P(X \cap Y) \cdot P\left(\frac{Z}{X \cap Y}\right)\) ...(2)
Putting (1) in (2):
\(P(X \cap Y \cap Z) = P(X) \cdot P\left(\frac{Y}{X}\right) \cdot P\left(\frac{Z}{X \cap Y}\right)\). Hence proved.
This multiplication theorem holds for any three events. When \(X\), \(Y\), \(Z\) are independent, \(P\left(\frac{Y}{X}\right) = P(Y)\) and \(P\left(\frac{Z}{X \cap Y}\right) = P(Z)\), so it becomes \(P(X \cap Y \cap Z) = P(X) \cdot P(Y) \cdot P(Z)\).
Q6e.hi:
माना \(X\), \(Y\), \(Z\) तीन घटनाएँ हैं (प्रश्न में इन्हें \(x, y, z\) लिखा है), जहाँ \(P(X) > 0\) तथा \(P(X \cap Y) > 0\)।
सप्रतिबंध प्रायिकता की परिभाषा से,
\(P\left(\frac{Y}{X}\right) = \frac{P(X \cap Y)}{P(X)}\), अतः \(P(X \cap Y) = P(X) \cdot P\left(\frac{Y}{X}\right)\) ...(1)
\(X \cap Y\) को एक घटना मानने पर,
\(P\left(\frac{Z}{X \cap Y}\right) = \frac{P((X \cap Y) \cap Z)}{P(X \cap Y)}\), अतः \(P(X \cap Y \cap Z) = P(X \cap Y) \cdot P\left(\frac{Z}{X \cap Y}\right)\) ...(2)
(1) को (2) में रखने पर:
\(P(X \cap Y \cap Z) = P(X) \cdot P\left(\frac{Y}{X}\right) \cdot P\left(\frac{Z}{X \cap Y}\right)\)। यही सिद्ध करना था।
प्रायिकता का यह गुणन प्रमेय किन्हीं भी तीन घटनाओं के लिए सत्य है। जब \(X\), \(Y\), \(Z\) स्वतन्त्र हों, तब \(P\left(\frac{Y}{X}\right) = P(Y)\) तथा \(P\left(\frac{Z}{X \cap Y}\right) = P(Z)\), अतः यह \(P(X \cap Y \cap Z) = P(X) \cdot P(Y) \cdot P(Z)\) हो जाता है।

Q8a.en:
Put \(x + y = v\). Then \(1 + \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dv}{dx}\), so \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dv}{dx} - 1\). The equation becomes
\(\frac{dv}{dx} - 1 = \frac{v + 1}{2v + 3}\), so \(\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{v + 1}{2v + 3} + 1 = \frac{3v + 4}{2v + 3}\).
Separating the variables: \(\frac{2v + 3}{3v + 4}\, dv = dx\).
Since \(2v + 3 = \frac{2}{3}(3v + 4) + \frac{1}{3}\), we have \(\frac{2v + 3}{3v + 4} = \frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{3v + 4}\).
Integrating both sides:
\(\int \left(\frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{3v + 4}\right) dv = \int dx\)
\(\frac{2}{3}v + \frac{1}{9}\log|3v + 4| = x + C_1\).
Multiplying by 9: \(6v + \log|3v + 4| = 9x + 9C_1\).
Putting back \(v = x + y\): \(6x + 6y + \log|3x + 3y + 4| = 9x + C\), where \(C = 9C_1\).
Hence the general solution is \(6y - 3x + \log|3x + 3y + 4| = C\).
Q8a.hi:
माना \(x + y = v\)। तब \(1 + \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dv}{dx}\), अतः \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dv}{dx} - 1\)। समीकरण हो जाता है
\(\frac{dv}{dx} - 1 = \frac{v + 1}{2v + 3}\), अतः \(\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{v + 1}{2v + 3} + 1 = \frac{3v + 4}{2v + 3}\)।
चरों को पृथक करने पर: \(\frac{2v + 3}{3v + 4}\, dv = dx\)।
चूँकि \(2v + 3 = \frac{2}{3}(3v + 4) + \frac{1}{3}\), अतः \(\frac{2v + 3}{3v + 4} = \frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{3v + 4}\)।
दोनों पक्षों का समाकलन करने पर:
\(\int \left(\frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{3v + 4}\right) dv = \int dx\)
\(\frac{2}{3}v + \frac{1}{9}\log|3v + 4| = x + C_1\)।
9 से गुणा करने पर: \(6v + \log|3v + 4| = 9x + 9C_1\)।
\(v = x + y\) पुनः रखने पर: \(6x + 6y + \log|3x + 3y + 4| = 9x + C\), जहाँ \(C = 9C_1\)।
अतः व्यापक हल \(6y - 3x + \log|3x + 3y + 4| = C\) है।

Q8b.en:
The equation can be written as
\(\frac{dx}{dy} = \frac{\tan^{-1} y - x}{1 + y^2}\), that is \(\frac{dx}{dy} + \frac{1}{1 + y^2}\,x = \frac{\tan^{-1} y}{1 + y^2}\).
This is a linear differential equation of the form \(\frac{dx}{dy} + P_1 x = Q_1\), with \(P_1 = \frac{1}{1 + y^2}\) and \(Q_1 = \frac{\tan^{-1} y}{1 + y^2}\).
Integrating factor \(= e^{\int P_1\, dy} = e^{\int \frac{dy}{1 + y^2}} = e^{\tan^{-1} y}\).
The solution is
\(x \cdot e^{\tan^{-1} y} = \int \frac{\tan^{-1} y}{1 + y^2}\, e^{\tan^{-1} y}\, dy + C\).
To evaluate the integral, put \(\tan^{-1} y = t\), so \(\frac{dy}{1 + y^2} = dt\):
\(\int t\, e^{t}\, dt = t\, e^{t} - \int 1 \cdot e^{t}\, dt = t\, e^{t} - e^{t} = e^{t}(t - 1) = e^{\tan^{-1} y}(\tan^{-1} y - 1)\) (integration by parts).
So \(x\, e^{\tan^{-1} y} = e^{\tan^{-1} y}(\tan^{-1} y - 1) + C\).
Dividing by \(e^{\tan^{-1} y}\), the general solution is
\(x = \tan^{-1} y - 1 + C e^{-\tan^{-1} y}\).
Q8b.hi:
दिए गए समीकरण को इस प्रकार लिखा जा सकता है:
\(\frac{dx}{dy} = \frac{\tan^{-1} y - x}{1 + y^2}\), अर्थात् \(\frac{dx}{dy} + \frac{1}{1 + y^2}\,x = \frac{\tan^{-1} y}{1 + y^2}\)।
यह \(\frac{dx}{dy} + P_1 x = Q_1\) के रूप का रैखिक अवकल समीकरण है, जहाँ \(P_1 = \frac{1}{1 + y^2}\) तथा \(Q_1 = \frac{\tan^{-1} y}{1 + y^2}\)।
समाकलन गुणक \(= e^{\int P_1\, dy} = e^{\int \frac{dy}{1 + y^2}} = e^{\tan^{-1} y}\)।
अतः हल है
\(x \cdot e^{\tan^{-1} y} = \int \frac{\tan^{-1} y}{1 + y^2}\, e^{\tan^{-1} y}\, dy + C\)।
समाकल ज्ञात करने के लिए \(\tan^{-1} y = t\) रखिए, तब \(\frac{dy}{1 + y^2} = dt\):
\(\int t\, e^{t}\, dt = t\, e^{t} - \int 1 \cdot e^{t}\, dt = t\, e^{t} - e^{t} = e^{t}(t - 1) = e^{\tan^{-1} y}(\tan^{-1} y - 1)\) (खंडशः समाकलन से)।
अतः \(x\, e^{\tan^{-1} y} = e^{\tan^{-1} y}(\tan^{-1} y - 1) + C\)।
\(e^{\tan^{-1} y}\) से भाग देने पर व्यापक हल
\(x = \tan^{-1} y - 1 + C e^{-\tan^{-1} y}\) है।

Q9a.en:
Since \(1 + \cos 4x = 2\cos^2 2x\), we have \(\sqrt{\frac{1 + \cos 4x}{2}} = \sqrt{\cos^2 2x} = |\cos 2x|\).
For \(0 \leq x \leq \frac{\pi}{4}\), \(0 \leq 2x \leq \frac{\pi}{2}\), so \(\cos 2x \geq 0\) and \(|\cos 2x| = \cos 2x\).
For \(\frac{\pi}{4} \leq x \leq \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(\frac{\pi}{2} \leq 2x \leq \pi\), so \(\cos 2x \leq 0\) and \(|\cos 2x| = -\cos 2x\).
Therefore
\(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \sqrt{\frac{1 + \cos 4x}{2}}\, dx = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \cos 2x\, dx - \int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2} \cos 2x\, dx\)
\(= \left[\frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right]_{0}^{\pi/4} - \left[\frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right]_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}\)
\(= \left(\frac{\sin\frac{\pi}{2}}{2} - \frac{\sin 0}{2}\right) - \left(\frac{\sin\pi}{2} - \frac{\sin\frac{\pi}{2}}{2}\right)\)
\(= \left(\frac{1}{2} - 0\right) - \left(0 - \frac{1}{2}\right) = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{2} = 1\).
Hence proved.

\(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \sqrt{\frac{1 + \cos 4x}{2}}\, dx = \int_{0}^{\pi/4} \cos 2x\, dx - \int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2} \cos 2x\, dx\)

Q9b.en:
Take \(a > 0\) and \(b > 0\).
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\, dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\) ...(1)
Using \(\int_0^a f(x)\, dx = \int_0^a f(a - x)\, dx\), with \(\cos(\pi - x) = -\cos x\) and \(\sin(\pi - x) = \sin x\):
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{(\pi - x)\, dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\) ...(2)
Adding (1) and (2):
\(2I = \pi \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\).
The integrand \(f(x) = \frac{1}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\) satisfies \(f(\pi - x) = f(x)\), so by the property \(\int_0^{2a} f(x)\, dx = 2\int_0^{a} f(x)\, dx\):
\(2I = 2\pi \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\), so \(I = \pi \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\).
Dividing numerator and denominator by \(\cos^2 x\):
\(I = \pi \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sec^2 x\, dx}{a^2 + b^2 \tan^2 x}\).
Put \(\tan x = t\), so \(\sec^2 x\, dx = dt\); when \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\), and as \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t \to \infty\):
\(I = \pi \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{dt}{a^2 + b^2 t^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2} \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{dt}{t^2 + \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2} \cdot \frac{b}{a}\left[\tan^{-1}\frac{bt}{a}\right]_{0}^{\infty}\)
\(= \frac{\pi}{ab}\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 0\right) = \frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\).
Hence \(I = \frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\).
Q9b.hi:
माना \(a > 0\) तथा \(b > 0\)।
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\, dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\) ...(1)
गुणधर्म \(\int_0^a f(x)\, dx = \int_0^a f(a - x)\, dx\) से, जहाँ \(\cos(\pi - x) = -\cos x\) तथा \(\sin(\pi - x) = \sin x\):
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{(\pi - x)\, dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\) ...(2)
(1) तथा (2) को जोड़ने पर:
\(2I = \pi \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\)।
समाकल्य \(f(x) = \frac{1}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\) के लिए \(f(\pi - x) = f(x)\), अतः गुणधर्म \(\int_0^{2a} f(x)\, dx = 2\int_0^{a} f(x)\, dx\) से:
\(2I = 2\pi \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\), अतः \(I = \pi \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2 \cos^2 x + b^2 \sin^2 x}\)।
अंश तथा हर को \(\cos^2 x\) से भाग देने पर:
\(I = \pi \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sec^2 x\, dx}{a^2 + b^2 \tan^2 x}\)।
\(\tan x = t\) रखने पर \(\sec^2 x\, dx = dt\); जब \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\), तथा जब \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t \to \infty\):
\(I = \pi \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{dt}{a^2 + b^2 t^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2} \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{dt}{t^2 + \left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2} \cdot \frac{b}{a}\left[\tan^{-1}\frac{bt}{a}\right]_{0}^{\infty}\)
\(= \frac{\pi}{ab}\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 0\right) = \frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\)।
अतः \(I = \frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\)।
